episodes.title: 10 Cult Leaders Who Convinced Their Followers
episodes.description:
Throughout history, charismatic leaders have used manipulation, isolation, and psychological control to convince ordinary people to give up their lives — sometimes by the hundreds. In this video, we count down 10 of the most notorious cult leaders whose followers died at their command, whether through mass suicide, violent standoffs, or so-called "revolutionary" sacrifice.
From the horrors of Jonestown to the Heaven's Gate tragedy, we break down how these leaders gained absolute control over their followers' minds, why so many people stayed until the very end, and what these dark chapters in history teach us about manipulation, groupthink, and the psychology of belief.

#cultleader #truecrimedocumentary 

⚠️ Disclaimer:
This documentary is for informational and educational purposes only. All information is sourced from public legal records, verified reporting, and documented trial outcomes. This video does not promote or glorify crime in any form. And yes, there could be some misinformation, but with no discriminatory intention.
